admission.justification: The capability and the example treatment both govern the relation between the essay and a supporting figure.

applicability: The essay and the supporting figures in a recorded or planned explanation.
conditions: The explainer completes the essay with evidence before planning or making visuals.
The published page carries the complete explanation in readable text.
exclusions: Figure behavior and visual treatment still apply when a figure is used.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_canvas_capsule_text.py asserts the sentence; sandbox pages read in full without motion

origin.handoffEntry: BUG-R13@v1 rule 3 — text carries the content

statement: The essay carries the content; a visual is made only where it helps a part of the essay, and the page reads in full without animations.
